data.title: Bitcoin Doesn’t Pay Dividends, So How Is This ETF Yielding 25%?
data.description: Bitcoin pays no dividends, coupons, or rents, yet one ETF is distributing cash to investors at a rate that rivals high-yield bonds and dividend stocks combined. The mechanism behind it reveals something uncomfortable about what income investors might actually be giving up.
data.keywords: BTCI, Bitcoin ETF, distribution, Retirement Income
